title: GPU Detail
description: One GPU in depth: live power, utilization, memory, thermals, clocks and what limits them, daily energy, state history, device identity and the health of the metrics path. nvidia_gpu_exporter in nvidia-smi mode (the NVML-only process/ECC/XID/MIG/PCIe-throughput metrics are not produced by this build).

list.name: host
list.label: Box
list.description: GPU box, by the host label vmagent stamps on every sample (listed if seen in the last 30 days).

list.name: gpu
list.label: GPU
list.description: GPU on the selected box: name, index and the first 8 characters of its UUID.

panels.description: Board power draw (nvidia-smi power.draw), averaged per sparkline step; the value is the latest step's average.
Share of time the SMs ran a kernel (utilization.gpu).
Framebuffer memory in use, including whatever the inference engine reserved up front.
GPU die temperature.
Degrees Celsius left before the driver's thermal slowdown point (temperature.gpu.tlimit). Amber under 10, red under 5.
Current graphics (shader) clock; SM clock tracks it exactly on this card.

Energy since local midnight: a running sum of per-step integrate() over the raw power samples (each window looks one step ahead so the day starts exactly at midnight and the last step reaches now). integrate() must wrap the raw selector -- integrate(max(m)[..]) is an implicit subquery that resamples and read 0.85% high.

What is holding the clocks back right now, most severe first: HW slowdown, power brake, HW thermal, SW thermal, SW power cap (the card at its power limit -- normal under full load), or a driver recovery action. Idle downclocking is not a limiter.

targets.expr: max(label_set(max(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sw_power_cap{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) * 1, "r", "a") or label_set(max(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sw_thermal_slowdown{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) * 2, "r", "b") or label_set(max(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_thermal_slowdown{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) * 3, "r", "c") or label_set(max(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_power_brake_slowdown{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) * 4, "r", "d") or label_set(max(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_slowdown{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) * 5, "r", "e") or label_set((max(nvidia_smi_gpu_recovery_action{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) > bool 0) * 6, "r", "f"))

panels.title: Power
panels.description: Board power per step: average (filled) and peak (thin line), against the enforced power limit (dashed). The axis keeps the whole budget in view so idle reads as idle; the peak line keeps short full-load bursts visible at long ranges.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Die temperature (hottest sample per step) against the driver's thermal slowdown point (dashed: temperature + temperature.gpu.tlimit headroom, hour-averaged because the two gauges are sampled a moment apart and jitter by 1 C).

panels.title: Daily Energy (30d)
panels.description: kWh per local day, today last (so far). integrate() over the raw power samples, looking FORWARD one day from each local-midnight step (offset -1d) -- the backward form draws each day on the next day's midnight. VictoriaMetrics stops the forward window at now, so today's bar is not extrapolated (verified against a raw-sample trapezoid, 2026-09-27).

panels.title: Utilization
panels.description: SM utilization and memory-controller (bus) utilization, averaged per step, on one 0-100% axis. This card also drives a display, so the memory bus stays busy (scan-out) even when compute is idle.

panels.title: VRAM
panels.description: Framebuffer split into used, driver-reserved and free; the stack sums to the card's total memory.

panels.title: Clocks
panels.description: Graphics and memory clocks as a share of each one's maximum (time-averaged per step), on one axis. Absolute values: the Graphics clock card and the Link & Limits table.

panels.title: Clock Limiter
panels.description: What limited the clocks over time, most severe reason per step (same coding as the Clock limiter card). Grey = nothing limiting. Power cap under full load is normal: the card is at its power limit.

targets.expr: max(label_set(max(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sw_power_cap{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) * 1, "r", "a") or label_set(max(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sw_thermal_slowdown{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) * 2, "r", "b") or label_set(max(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_thermal_slowdown{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) * 3, "r", "c") or label_set(max(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_power_brake_slowdown{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) * 4, "r", "d") or label_set(max(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_slowdown{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) * 5, "r", "e") or label_set((max(nvidia_smi_gpu_recovery_action{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) > bool 0) * 6, "r", "f"))

panels.title: Throttled
panels.description: Total time any throttle reason held the clocks over the dashboard range, from the driver's cumulative clock-event counters (catches events between scrapes that the instantaneous flags miss). SW power cap dominates on this card.

panels.title: P-State
panels.description: Performance state, P0 = maximum performance, P8 and up = idle. Shows the highest-performance state reached in each step (min over the interval) so short bursts are not lost at long ranges; shades run from bright (busy) to dark (idle).

panels.title: Device
panels.description: Identity of the selected GPU from nvidia_smi_gpu_info (last seen within 30 days).

targets.expr: max by (name, driver_version, cuda_version, vbios_version, compute_cap, driver_model_current, pci_bus_id)(last_over_time(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}[30d]))

panels.title: Link & Limits
panels.description: Where the card sits against its own ceilings right now: power against the enforced limit, VRAM against capacity, clocks against their maxima, and the PCIe link against what the card supports (a link running narrower than its maximum -- e.g. x8 of x16 -- is set by the slot or riser; it barely matters for inference, where weights stay on the card).

targets.expr: label_set(round(round(max(nvidia_smi_power_draw_watts{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"})), 0.1), "item", "Power (W)", "o", "1") or label_set(round(max(nvidia_smi_memory_used_bytes{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) / 1073741824, 0.1), "item", "VRAM (GiB)", "o", "2") or label_set(round(max(nvidia_smi_clocks_current_graphics_clock_hz{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) / 1e6, 0.1), "item", "Graphics clock (MHz)", "o", "3") or label_set(round(max(nvidia_smi_clocks_current_memory_clock_hz{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) / 1e6, 0.1), "item", "Memory clock (MHz)", "o", "4") or label_set(round(max(nvidia_smi_pcie_link_gen_current{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}), 0.1), "item", "PCIe generation", "o", "5") or label_set(round(max(nvidia_smi_pcie_link_width_current{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}), 0.1), "item", "PCIe lanes", "o", "6")

label_set(round(max(nvidia_smi_enforced_power_limit_watts{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}), 0.1), "item", "Power (W)", "o", "1") or label_set(round(max(nvidia_smi_memory_total_bytes{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) / 1073741824, 0.1), "item", "VRAM (GiB)", "o", "2") or label_set(round(max(nvidia_smi_clocks_max_graphics_clock_hz{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) / 1e6, 0.1), "item", "Graphics clock (MHz)", "o", "3") or label_set(round(max(nvidia_smi_clocks_max_memory_clock_hz{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) / 1e6, 0.1), "item", "Memory clock (MHz)", "o", "4") or label_set(round(max(nvidia_smi_pcie_link_gen_max{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}), 0.1), "item", "PCIe generation", "o", "5") or label_set(round(max(nvidia_smi_pcie_link_width_max{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}), 0.1), "item", "PCIe lanes", "o", "6")

label_set((round(max(nvidia_smi_power_draw_watts{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}))) / (max(nvidia_smi_enforced_power_limit_watts{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"})), "item", "Power (W)", "o", "1") or label_set((max(nvidia_smi_memory_used_bytes{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) / 1073741824) / (max(nvidia_smi_memory_total_bytes{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) / 1073741824), "item", "VRAM (GiB)", "o", "2") or label_set((max(nvidia_smi_clocks_current_graphics_clock_hz{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) / 1e6) / (max(nvidia_smi_clocks_max_graphics_clock_hz{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) / 1e6), "item", "Graphics clock (MHz)", "o", "3") or label_set((max(nvidia_smi_clocks_current_memory_clock_hz{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) / 1e6) / (max(nvidia_smi_clocks_max_memory_clock_hz{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"}) / 1e6), "item", "Memory clock (MHz)", "o", "4") or label_set((max(nvidia_smi_pcie_link_gen_current{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"})) / (max(nvidia_smi_pcie_link_gen_max{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"})), "item", "PCIe generation", "o", "5") or label_set((max(nvidia_smi_pcie_link_width_current{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"})) / (max(nvidia_smi_pcie_link_width_max{job="gpu",host=~"$host",uuid=~"$gpu"})), "item", "PCIe lanes", "o", "6")

panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: Health of the metrics path on the GPU box: the vmagent scrape of the exporter, whether the exporter's last nvidia-smi call succeeded, how long it took, failed scrapes over the dashboard range, and how old the newest GPU sample is.
